title: Crane Lift Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Crane Lift Job Safety Analysis template for construction you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers lift information, job steps & hazard analysis.
html:
Lift Information

JSA ID: CRANE-__________ DATE: ______________ TIME: ______________

PROJECT: ______________ LOCATION: ______________ LIFT TYPE: ☐ Critical ☐ Standard

CRANE TYPE: ______________ CAPACITY: ______________ tons LOAD WEIGHT: ______________ lbs

LIFT DIRECTOR: ______________ OPERATOR: ______________ SIGNAL PERSON: ______________

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Pre-Lift Planning-Power lines
-Soft ground
-Obstructions
-Weather		-Electrocution
-Tip over
-Collision
-Load drop		25 (VERY HIGH)-Survey site for overhead hazards
-Verify ground bearing capacity
-Maintain 20ft from power lines
-Check wind speed (max 25mph)
2. Crane Setup & Leveling-Outrigger failure
-Unstable ground		-Settlement
-Tip over
-Structural collapse		20 (VERY HIGH)-Fully extend outriggers
-Use crane mats/cribbing
-Level crane within 1%
-Verify all pins locked
3. Rigging Inspection & Setup-Worn slings
-Wrong hitch
-Overloaded shackles		-Dropped load
-Property damage
-Fatality		16 (HIGH)-Inspect all rigging before use
-Verify sling angles (>60°)
-Match capacity to load weight
-Use spreader bars for wide loads
4. Lift Execution-Workers in swing radius
-Communication failure		-Struck by load
-Misunderstood commands		20 (VERY HIGH)-Barricade swing radius
-Use tag lines on all loads
-Test radio communication
-Establish hand signals backup
5. Load Placement-Unstable landing
-Crew under suspended load		-Load shift
-Pinch points
-Crush injuries		12 (HIGH)-Lower load slowly
-Use cribbing for level landing
-Keep hands clear of landing area
-Never walk under suspended load
6. Post-Lift Shutdown-Unsecured crane
-Unauthorized use		-Shift during wind
-Unauthorized operation		8 (MODERATE)-Secure crane for overnight
-Lower boom to transport position
-Remove keys from ignition
-Document lift in log

CRITICAL LIFT CHECKLIST (if applicable): ☐ Pre-lift meeting ☐ Third-party inspection ☐ Engineering review

REQUIRED PPE: ☐ Hard Hat ☐ Safety Glasses ☐ High-Vis Vest ☐ Steel-Toe Boots ☐ Gloves ☐ Hearing Protection
